name: The Tickets tab displays data correctly

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "1250"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('1', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('2', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('0', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Hilary" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
And I should see the "Manicure" service
When I add the "Manicure" service to my cart
And I select the "GIFT CARD" category
And I add the "Shampoo" service to my cart
And I add the "Gift card $100" service to my cart
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "Activate Gift Card $100.00"
And I click on the "OK" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see the number card "2222" visible
When I click on the "ADD ON" button in the popup dialog
Then I should see the service "Gift card $100 (2222)" in my cart
And I should see my cart showing 3 item added
When I select the service "Manicure" in my cart
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I click on the "Pay" button
And I select the "Cash" payment type
And I select the "Credit" payment type
And I fill the last 4 digits of card number "1234"
And I select the "VISA" on the menu
Then I should see the payment history "VISA (1234)$173.76 + $10.00" visible
When I click on the "Close Ticket" button
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Close Ticket', exact: true })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
Given I am on the TICKET_PAYMENTS page
When I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the "Ticket Payments" screen
When I wait for the page fully loaded
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the "Total Sale" has value "$218.70" in the ticket payment
And I should see the "Payment" has value "$232.26" in the ticket payment
And I should see the "Surcharge" has value "$0.00" in the ticket payment
And I should see the "Card Fee" has value "$3.56" in the ticket payment
And I should see the "Tip" has value "$10.00" in the ticket payment
And I should see the "Tax" has value "$0.00" in the ticket payment
When I back to HOME page
And I select the "CLOSED TICKET" tab
And I wait for the page fully loaded
And I wait for the page fully loaded
Then I should see the first ticket of payment "232.26"
When I reopen to void ticket with payment amount "$232.26"

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$232.26' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$232.26' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()

Click locator('.MuiDataGrid-row').filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentTotal"]').filter({ hasText: '$232.26' }) }).filter({ has: locator('[data-field="paymentMethod"]').filter({ hasText: /.+/ }) }).first().locator('[data-field="avatar"]').first()
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
And I should not see the employee "Hilary" in the ticket list
